tlmcw.read_menu_description:
[%1$s] your maid: read her configuration.
Replace the draft's areas, names, routes and schedule.
Reading and editing leave the maid unchanged.
Reapply after editing to update her settings.
tlmcw.read_hint: Read tool: [%1$s] your maid to copy her configuration into the compass draft
tlmcw.read_not_owner: Only the owner can read this maid's configuration, using the main hand.
tlmcw.maid_no_config: This maid has no addon configuration. The compass draft is unchanged.
tlmcw.maid_read: Read: %s work / %s rest / %s sleep areas, plus routes and schedule.
tlmcw.rename_menu_description:
[%1$s] a cuboid: edit its name.
Tags show the name and area type.
An empty name restores its number.
Apply again to update your maid.
tlmcw.schedule_menu_description:
[%1$s]: open the work timetable.
Edit destinations and delays.
Reorder, duplicate and loop entries.
Apply again to update your maid.
tlmcw.schedule_edit_hint: [%1$s]: edit the timetable; work for the delay, then travel to the next entry
tlmcw.editor_stale: The compass or draft changed. Open the editor again.
tlmcw.editor_saved: Draft saved. Choose Apply to Maid to update your maid.
tlmcw.rename_note: Up to 64 characters; empty restores the area number.
tlmcw.schedule_empty:
No entries: default rotation will be used.
Select and mark at least one Work Area first.
tlmcw.schedule_reorder: Move this entry up or down
tlmcw.condition_edit_hint: Click to edit the departure condition
tlmcw.save_condition: Confirm condition and return to the timetable
tlmcw.condition_note:
Counts active working game ticks after arrival.
Travel, idle and sleep pause the delay.
Scroll to adjust; hold Shift for larger steps.
tlmcw.condition_invalid: Enter an integer from 0 to %s game ticks.
tlmcw.destination_work_only: Choose the Work Area for this entry
tlmcw.save_destination: Confirm destination and return to the timetable
tlmcw.mark_menu_description:
[%1$s] a box: change its purpose.
Work → Idle → Sleep → Work.
Existing graph connections stay.
Apply again to update your maid.
tlmcw.apply_menu_description:
[%1$s] your maid: apply.
[%2$s] + [%1$s] your maid: reset.
Enable Home to use schedule areas.
tlmcw.mark_edit_hint: [%1$s] a cuboid: cycle Work, Idle and Sleep
tlmcw.aim_maid: Press [%1$s] on your maid to apply.
tlmcw.select_apply_tool: Choose Apply to Maid in the [%1$s] menu.
tlmcw.clear_edit_tool: Switch to Cuboids or Route Nodes to clear nodes.
tlmcw.menu_scroll: Scroll to choose; release %1$s to confirm
tlmcw.work_menu_description:
[%1$s] two corners: add a box.
New boxes are Work Areas.
[%2$s] a box: delete it.
[%3$s] + [%1$s]: cancel.
tlmcw.route_menu_description:
[%1$s] a node: start or connect.
Elsewhere: add at your feet.
While linking, [%2$s]: cancel.
Otherwise [%2$s]: delete node/edges.
tlmcw.route_edit_hint: [%1$s]: connect or add at your feet; [%2$s]: cancel a pending link, otherwise delete
tlmcw.select_route_start: Press [%1$s] on an existing cuboid or route node to start.
tlmcw.route_start: Start selected. Walk to the next point and press [%1$s] to connect.
tlmcw.route_deleted: Route node or its connections removed.
tlmcw.graph_full: The route graph has reached its limit (256 points / 2048 edges).
tlmcw.edit_hint: [%1$s] twice: add a box; [%3$s] + [%1$s]: cancel; [%2$s] a box: delete
tlmcw.apply_hint: Apply tool: [%1$s] your maid; [%2$s] + [%1$s]: restore original schedule areas
tlmcw.first_corner: First corner selected. Press [%1$s] on another block to confirm.
tlmcw.wrong_dimension: The draft belongs to a different dimension. Clear both cuboids and route points to start again.
tlmcw.too_many: At most %s cuboids are allowed across all three types.
tlmcw.too_large: The area exceeds the size limit or world bounds.
tlmcw.area_added: Cuboid %s added (%s × %s × %s blocks), marked as Work.
tlmcw.work_areas_cleared: Cuboids and their edges cleared. Route points and their connections are retained.
tlmcw.route_points_cleared: Intermediate route points and their edges cleared. Cuboids and their direct connections are retained.
tlmcw.not_owner: Only the owner can change this maid's schedule areas, using the main hand.
tlmcw.no_areas: Select at least one schedule area first.
tlmcw.maid_cleared: Original schedule-area behavior restored. Original schedule points are retained.
tlmcw.maid_applied: Applied: %s work / %s idle / %s sleep areas. Enable Home.
tlmcw.route_anchor_missing: The starting node is missing from this plan. Press [%1$s] to cancel and select a new start.
tlmcw.data_unreadable: Unknown configuration format. Original data preserved; editing disabled. Check the log.
